SELECT t.kind,COUNT(*) AS task_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('WAITING','READY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waiting_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_tasks, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(1,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_call_turns r WHERE r.call_id=c.id)) END),0) AS model_calls, COALESCE(SUM(c.input_tokens),0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(c.output_tokens),0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(c.actual),0) AS settled_cost, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.actual IS NULL AND c.status<>'REJECTED' THEN c.reserved ELSE 0 END),0) AS pending_reservation, SUM(CASE WHEN c.status='UNCERTAIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS uncertain_calls FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN model_calls c ON c.task_id=t.id
t.novel_id=#{novelId}AND t.user_id=#{scopeUser} GROUP BY t.kind ORDER BY t.kind
